description:
[Market] Every Rust skin marketplace: seller fee, payment and cash-out methods, activity. The directory on rust.wiki/marketplaces. `tracked` - the sites whose prices we read, busiest first: `label`,
`domain`, seller `fee` %, `trade_site` (you trade with the site's bot instead of listing), `skins_listed`,
`listings`, `listed_value` (cents), `buy_orders` and `buyback` (skins you can sell into now), `sales` (skins with
recorded sales), `status` of our feed, and `pay` (`deposit` and `cashout` methods, `note`). `other_sites` - more
Rust skin sites, payment methods only. Methods change often and vary by country: `checked` says when they were
last confirmed; check on the site before relying on one. Steam pays out to your Steam Wallet only. Seller fees and the ways to pay and cash out (PayPal, card, crypto, bank...) on each Rust skin site.

cash_out.description: Only sites you can CASH OUT to this kind of method from.

pay_with.description: Only sites you can PAY with this kind of method on.
